findings.message: The AudioSpecificConfig signals no SBR, but 12 of 12 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC, signaled only implicitly, with an output rate of 44100 Hz. Decoders without SBR play the AAC LC core at 22050 Hz.
12 raw data blocks hold the parametric stereo extension's ID in a channel pair's SBR data, where only a single channel element can carry it, so decoders do not apply it; the first at 0x312.
